Focuses on WHO is to blame (prosecutors vs mayor) rather than WHAT structural supports students actually need.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Lesser Evil. Punitive theater replaces systemic repair.

The Unavoidable Truth: Punitive grand juries will not fix systemic truancy.

The Unavoidable Lie: This investigation is solely about administrative paperwork.
